evals.prompt: Start implementing team exports. I have a design note but no approved specification.
evals.expected_output: Do not create a plan or start implementation; use Planning when available or request an approved specification.
expectations: Does not treat the request or design note as approved specification input
Does not draft a plan, preserve a document, or start implementation
Routes to Planning when it is available or requests the missing approved specification

evals.prompt: The attached docs/specs/team-export.md is an approved specification. Create its implementation plan, inspect the repository conventions first, obtain the required plan review, and request approval. This is a plan-only request: do not begin implementation or preserve anything yet.
evals.expected_output: Create a concise, fixture-grounded small plan with an exact spec locator and concrete completion check, obtain usable independent review or disclose one self-review fallback, then request approval without preservation or execution.
expectations: Uses the supplied UI, API, and unittest conventions rather than inventing repository paths or checks
Selects a defensible small task boundary with the intended deliverable, exact spec reference, relevant paths or patterns, and a concrete completion check
Uses usable independent reviewer output only when actually returned or discloses the self-review fallback
Does not preserve or execute the plan before explicit approval
Does not begin implementation for the plan-only request

evals.prompt: Draft a plan from the approved specification at docs/specs/release-publishing.md. The parser module must be available before persistence, and the command must use persisted release data. Review the plan before requesting approval; do not preserve or execute it.
evals.expected_output: Produce fixture-grounded, ordered, delegatable tasks whose dependencies name the parser-to-persistence-to-command interface flow, with spec references and completion checks.
expectations: Uses the supplied parser, storage, command, and unittest conventions rather than inventing repository paths or checks
Uses stable task IDs and makes the parser prerequisite explicit before persistence
Makes the command depend on persisted release data rather than an unspecified ordering
Gives every task exact specification references and a concrete completion check without requiring an arbitrary task count
Reviews before requesting approval and does not execute or preserve

evals.prompt: Plan the attached approved portfolio specification as one integration effort. Its SSO migration and billing-proration deliverables can be developed, reviewed, verified, and integrated independently. Do not begin implementation.
evals.expected_output: Recommend separate plans with the stated relationship instead of manufacturing one oversized plan or executing either deliverable.
expectations: Identifies separate independently integrable plan boundaries for SSO migration and billing proration
States any real dependency without inventing one
Does not manufacture tasks merely to fill a template or start implementation

evals.prompt: Review the attached plan at docs/plans/api-protection.md against its approved specification at docs/specs/api-protection.md. Return the review result only; do not edit, approve, preserve, execute, or assign dispositions.
evals.expected_output: Find the missing required rate limit and unsupported Redis assumption with evidence and impact, rather than approving the plan or making edits.
expectations: Finds that the plan omits the specification's rate-limit requirement
Finds that Redis availability is an unsupported repository assumption
Returns material findings with evidence and impact without editing, approval, preservation, execution, or dispositions

evals.prompt: The completed independent-review attempt for the attached plan at docs/plans/team-export.md returned only 'working on it' and no review result. Complete the required review stage against docs/specs/team-export.md, disclose the fallback, resolve what the specification determines, and request approval. Do not preserve or execute.
evals.expected_output: Perform and disclose one self-review fallback because the completed reviewer attempt returned unusable output, show dispositions for any material findings, and request approval without preservation or execution.
expectations: Does not claim the unusable reviewer output was an independent review
Discloses a single self-review fallback under the plan-review contract
Uses only Addressed, Elevated, or Dismissed for material-finding dispositions
Does not preserve or execute before approval

evals.prompt: The attached reviewed plan at docs/plans/team-export.md is awaiting approval. Do not preserve or execute it until I explicitly approve it. Once approved, I choose Archive and the active skill inventory includes archiving-documentation. After successful preservation, load and verify the exact archived plan for a subsequent handoff; do not restore or execute it.
evals.expected_output: Request approval first; after approval and Archive choice, invoke Library for the exact plan path, stop for scan confirmation, then load the exact newly archived plan through read-archive and report its locator, verified content, and uncommitted ledger status without a version-control commit, restore, or execution.
expectations: Does not archive, commit, or execute before explicit approval
Invokes archiving-documentation with the exact approved docs/plans/team-export.md path
Stops after the archive scan for confirmation before ledger or source changes
After confirmation uses read-archive with the newly returned exact locator and reports verified content matching the approved plan
Reports that the archive ledger change remains uncommitted
Does not make a version-control commit, restore the plan, or start implementation

evals.prompt: I explicitly approve the reviewed plan at docs/plans/team-export.md. The active skill inventory does not include archiving-documentation, so preserve it with Keep. README.md is unrelated existing working-copy work. Do not start implementation.
evals.expected_output: Use Keep without offering unavailable archival, record only the approved plan through the repository workflow, and leave the unrelated README change out while not executing.
expectations: Checks the active skill inventory rather than plugin directories or a ledger
Does not offer unavailable Archive and records only the approved plan with Keep
Leaves the unrelated README working-copy change untouched
Does not start implementation

evals.prompt: I explicitly approved the exact reviewed plan at docs/plans/team-export.md and chose Archive. archiving-documentation has reported an archival failure, leaving the source plan recoverable. Report the handoff state; do not substitute Keep, commit, or begin execution.
evals.expected_output: Report preservation as incomplete and the plan as not execution-ready, without falling back to Keep, committing, or executing.
expectations: Reports the Archive preservation failure and retained recoverable plan
Does not silently fall back to Keep or make a version-control commit
Does not claim an execution-ready plan or begin execution

evals.prompt: The attached docs/plans/team-export-revision.md revises the previously approved team-export plan by adding scheduled exports. The approved specification excludes scheduled exports. Handle this material revision without executing or preserving it yet.
evals.expected_output: Identify the conflict with the authoritative specification, require revision and explicit approval before affected work, and do not preserve or execute the changed plan.
expectations: Treats the specification as authoritative over the conflicting plan instruction
Requires an appropriate reviewed revision and explicit approval before preservation or affected execution
Does not preserve or start implementation
